nodes.question: Why is the conservation and restoration of mangroves considered a win-win-win solution?
nodes.answer: The conservation and restoration of mangroves are considered a win-win-win solution because they enhance biodiversity, mitigate climate change, and support the livelihoods of people in coastal areas.
